claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.DecideRefereeDir (0x0600508C) is an instance one-Int32-parameter method named pl_idx with an exact 107-byte body. It loads PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(pl_idx), tests the returned object through MemberRef 0x0A00002A op_Implicit, and returns raw 1 when that test is false. Otherwise it computes a Vector2 local from UnityEngine.Vector2.op_Implicit(targetPlayer.PlPos - this.PlPos). It compares local.x with raw Float32 0.0f using bgt.un. When that branch is not taken, meaning ordered x <= 0, it compares local.y with raw 0.0f using bgt.un and returns raw 1 when that second branch is not taken or raw 2 when it is taken. When the x bgt.un branch is taken, meaning x > 0 or unordered, it compares local.y with raw 0.0f using bgt.un and returns raw 5 when that branch is not taken or raw 4 when it is taken. Thus the exact return set in this helper is raw {1,2,4,5}; raw 3 is not returned by this method. FACT-0085 pins four direct caller sites at IL+0x0095, 0x016F, 0x01A9 and 0x01EB.
